units.source_text: 飞奔着火车的这条路线，是通向我故乡的熟悉的路线。

en.t: This route, along which the train was racing, was the familiar route that led to my hometown.

units.source_text: 不过，我从来没有以这样新鲜、这样稀罕的姿态眺望过这样陈旧的熏黑了的列车。

en.t: Yet I had never looked at such an old, soot-blackened train with such fresh and rare wonder.

units.source_text: 车站、汽笛，乃至黎明时分扩音器混浊的回响，都重复着同样的一种感情，

en.t: The station, the whistle, even the murky echo of the loudspeaker at daybreak, all repeated the same feeling,

units.source_text: 强化这一种感情，在我眼前展开了净是令人醒目的抒情的展望。

en.t: strengthening that feeling and unfolding before my eyes a prospect filled only with striking lyricism.

units.source_text: 旭日把宽阔的月台划分成段。

en.t: The rising sun divided the broad platform into sections.

units.source_text: 奔跑在上面的鞋声、裂开的木屣声、平静而单调的不停的铃声，

en.t: The sound of shoes running across it, the clatter of split wooden clogs, the calm, monotonous, unceasing bell,

units.source_text: 以及从站上小贩的篮子里拿出来的蜜桔的颜色……

en.t: and the color of the mandarin oranges taken from the station vendor's basket...

units.source_text: 所有这一切，仿佛都是委身于我的庞大的一个个暗示和一个个先兆。

en.t: all of these seemed like immense hints and omens, each one giving itself over to me.
